battery_capture_unavailable: Global reset is intentionally disabled; live capture uses read-only cumulative snapshots.
battery_historian_unavailable: Bugreport collection and the Legacy Historian adapter are not connected. No bugreport is generated or uploaded.
battery_configuration_unavailable: Capture settings are read-only until the Rust battery capture adapter is connected. They do not configure imported reports.
battery_imported_count: {count} imported report · not a saved capture session
battery_session_store_unavailable: Saved-session indexing is not connected; only current reports are listed.
battery_refresh_unavailable: There is no saved-session index to refresh. Re-import a report to reload its contents.
battery_empty_hint: Explicitly run a read-only capture or import a report. Opening this page does not start collection.
battery_derived_notice: Imported report: supplied evidence and source labels are not independently verified. Shared UID does not establish per-package ownership.
battery_energy_omitted: {count} energy records retained in details; incompatible components, sources or scopes are not combined into one scalar.
battery_baseline_unavailable: The previous published experiment is not a qualified baseline.
battery_baseline_compatible: Matching experiment evidence: descriptive network difference only.
battery_baseline_evidence_boundary: Workload is user-declared. Imported evidence is source-supplied, not live verification. Thermal conditions are not controlled; this is not a causal or statistically significant regression verdict.
battery_baseline_missing_identity: Missing device, package, UID or recognized attribution scope.
battery_baseline_different_identity: Device, package, UID or attribution scope differs.
battery_baseline_missing_workload: An explicit workload ID is missing; package identity is not workload evidence.
battery_baseline_missing_configuration: Effective capture configuration was not retained.
battery_baseline_missing_completion: Experiment completion or early-stop evidence was not retained.
battery_baseline_different_configuration: Capture mode or effective duration, polling, run count or cooldown differs.
battery_baseline_incomplete_runs: Run count, observed duration or early-stop status does not meet the requested experiment.
battery_baseline_missing_snapshots: Before/after snapshot evidence was not retained for every run.
battery_baseline_invalid_snapshots: Snapshot identity, boot/statistics continuity, interval or network counters do not match the report.
battery_baseline_missing_charging: Charging evidence is missing from a snapshot.
battery_baseline_different_charging: Charging state differs or changed during an experiment.
battery_baseline_missing_network: Network evidence is incomplete; missing counters are not zero.
battery_baseline_zero: Baseline network median is zero; percentage change is undefined.
battery_export_scope: File exports contain the published runs page only; not a raw evidence bundle or a lossless session archive.
battery_warning_scope: Imported diagnostics are retained verbatim; they are not newly verified findings.
battery_more_warnings: {count} more diagnostics omitted from this view
battery_status_retained: Operation ended; the previously published report is retained.
battery_config_read_only: Reference options only — capture settings are not applied.
battery_timer_coverage: Reported timer records only; omitted resource arrays are unavailable, not zero activity.
battery_energy_unverified: Source, scope and confidence are imported labels, not independent verification or hardware-measurement proof.
battery_live_select_target: Select an online device and application process in the title bar.
battery_live_consent: Start read-only BatteryStats polling for the displayed device and package. No global reset or battery-state changes are performed.
battery_live_captured: Live snapshots from this device · UID cumulative deltas require boot/statistics continuity; shared UID is not per-package ownership.
battery_live_configuration: Changes apply to the next explicitly started capture. Interactive stops on request; every capture has a duration ceiling.
battery_capture_select_target: Select an online device and running app process in the title bar.
battery_capture_consent: Read cumulative BatteryStats for the displayed package's verified runtime UID, device battery/thermal state and installation metadata. This does not launch or restart the app, reset global battery statistics, or change device settings.
battery_capture_configuration_hint: Uses the displayed configuration. Interactive and Online collection are bounded; Online polling lasts at least 30 seconds.
battery_capture_stop_requested: Stopping and analyzing the final read-only snapshot…
battery_capture_live_notice: Live UID-bound cumulative differences. Battery temperature is not CPU temperature; modeled energy is not direct measurement. Unknown or reset counters remain unavailable.
battery_capture_bundle_scope: Minimized evidence for the active live capture only: selected UID counters, battery/thermal state, installation metadata and reimportable analysis.json. No raw whole-device dump, history, APK or signatures. Device and selected UID identifiers are included.
battery_capture_bundle_unavailable: The active report has no matching owned live capture bundle. Imported reports cannot export a previous capture's evidence.
